effects.effect: Each time you finish a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), you can choose yourself or one ally who is also finishing a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite) to gain the benefit of a divine ritual. You place a ray of [morning light](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.conduit.level-2/morning-light) into the chosen character's soul, granting them a +1 [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to [saving throws](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) that lasts until you finish another [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite).
